RETURN t.name AS technician_name, e.equipment_id AS equipment_id,
       m.event_id AS event_id, m.event_type AS event_type,

questions.question: 설비별 가장 긴 단일 중단 시간을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (e:Equipment {project_id: 'equipment-history'})
      -[:HAS_MAINTENANCE]->(m:MaintenanceEvent {project_id: 'equipment-history'})
RETURN e.equipment_id AS equipment_id,
       max(m.downtime_hours) AS max_downtime_hours
ORDER BY max_downtime_hours DESC

questions.question: 각 설비의 정비 유형별 건수를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (e:Equipment {project_id: 'equipment-history'})
      -[:HAS_MAINTENANCE]->(m:MaintenanceEvent {project_id: 'equipment-history'})
RETURN e.equipment_id AS equipment_id, m.event_type AS event_type,
       count(m) AS event_count
ORDER BY equipment_id, event_type

questions.question: repair 작업에서 부품별 발생 건수를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (m:MaintenanceEvent {project_id: 'equipment-history'})
WHERE m.event_type = 'repair'
RETURN m.component AS component, count(m) AS event_count
ORDER BY event_count DESC, component
